title: I got tired of craps games that feel like slot machines, so I made one with real dice physics... Super Craps (free, browser)
author: couldgiveaflyingfck
selftext:
[https://youtu.be/9u-A\_o-ECvI](https://youtu.be/9u-A_o-ECvI)



Played craps for years. Every craps game I tried felt like a slot machine in a craps costume, so I built my own. Started as a gift for my ex father-in-law Eric, who's an advanced player, so it had to be legit.



\*\*The big thing:\*\* the dice are real physics. They fly, hit the back wall, bounce off the felt and whatever lands is your roll. No hidden random number deciding it for you.



\*\*What you get:\*\*



\* 3D 14 ft casino table you can spin and zoom around

\* Every bet a real table has. Pass, Don't, Come, odds, place, buy, lay, field, hardways, props, hop bets

\* Collect, Keep or Press on every win, drag chips between bets like real rules allow

\* Throw screen with grips and flourishes, a little bullet time, then the camera chases the dice down the table

\* Vinnie the stickman calling the game, casino noise in the background

\* Pick your felt, dice and wood colors



\*\*The math:\*\* every throw is modeled on a 6 ft adult's arm swing and release. Payouts match a Vegas table, so the house edge is the same... about 1.4% on the Pass Line, a hair less on the Don't, odds pay true. Props will eat you alive just like the real thing. Grips don't change the odds (they don't in Vegas either) but they sure feel good.



You start with a $100 buy-in. Bust and it's game over. Table goals at $200, $500 and $1,000.



Free to play here: COMING SOON



Solo retired dev, so tell me what's broken. Dont players welcome, I'm one of you.

  
This is around my 20th game I've dev'd. It gets easier. Maybe 3 hours total time, and 50'ish prompts
